context: 6 Open Questions We know for any positive integers s and k such that 2s − 1 > k that there is a ≤ps-T -complete set for NEXP that is not ≤pk-tt -autoreducible. We do not know what happens when 2s −1 ≤ k. It is not known whether every Turing-complete set is Turing-autoreducible. Referring to Theorem 9, the situation for ≤pk-tt -reductions for k ≥ 4 is still open. Acknowledgements.
